main.description: Updates an article draft using private storage (stash). If the draft ID does not point to an existing draft, this is treated as a draft creation - the same Striker-role and drafts-limit checks createDraft enforces are applied here too. Requires authentication. THIS IS A TEMPORARY UNSPECCED ROUTE, specific to this fork's article-authoring feature.

errors.name: NotAStriker
errors.description: The authenticated account does not have the Striker role, and the target draft ID does not already exist.

errors.name: ArticleDraftLimitReached
errors.description: The target draft ID does not already exist, and creating it would exceed the account's drafts limit.
